decision: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the suspension has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
reason: Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber changed the setup of the suspension of Car 24 under Parc Ferme, without the approval of the Technical Delegate. This is not in accordance with Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Car 24 is therefore required to start the Sprint from pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 24 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber
